componentSpecs.name: KnexLeaveTypeRepository
componentSpecs.description: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of ILeaveTypeRepository using Knex query builder. Constructor accepts optional Knex instance (defaults to creating one from DATABASE_URL). Maps snake_case DB columns (is_active, created_at, updated_at) to camelCase LeaveType model fields via private toLeaveType mapper. Methods: findAll (filters is_active=true), findById, findByCode, create (inserts with snake_case mapping, returns via returning('*')).

componentSpecs.name: knexfile.ts
componentSpecs.description: Knex configuration file exporting Knex.Config with client 'pg', connection from DATABASE_URL env var, migrations directory './migrations' with TypeScript extension 'ts'. Used by Knex CLI for running migrations and by repositories for database access.

componentSpecs.name: 001_create_leave_types migration
componentSpecs.description: Knex migration: up creates leave_types table with uuid id PK (default gen_random_uuid()), code varchar(50) unique not null, label varchar(100) not null, description text not null default '', is_active boolean not null default true, created_at/updated_at timestamps defaulting to now(). down drops the table.
